blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197398 the current implementation and native role memberships remain unchanged. FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE checks restrict transfers, staking and unstaking. DEFAULT_ADMIN can redistributeLockedAmount by burning a restricted balance and reminting it elsewhere, or seizeCooldown from the silo; the owner cannot be blacklisted. Monad block 113592633 and Pharos block 20300349 have byte-identical 7007-byte StakedTrUSDL2 runtimes, whose verified Monad source checks sender/recipient blackList on every transfer/mint/burn and permits owner-only redistribution. Both spokes name 0xb1e50b7a19b8f650a6ee77dc0ac52b88059fa169 as blackLister. Bridge mint/burn administration remains separate bridge risk.

oracleRisk.summary: Share conversion uses trUSD balance minus unvested rewards; authorized rewards and loss reports alter NAV. This is an upgradeable internal pricing authority, not an independent dollar oracle. Sherlock (15–22 Jan 2026) and Nethermind (24–26 Mar 2026) explicitly covered strUSD/access/oracle integration; both predate the current implementation activated 30 Sep 2026, so current build/audit equivalence is not claimed. The public continuous bounty is up to $1M critical.

branchApplicability.rationale: The ERC-4626 asset-per-share rate controls deposit and withdrawal amounts, without borrower debt or local liquidation branches.
